about.title: About us
about.p1: Malu Aviation is a company born in 1993 by the will of two airline pilots. The first plane they operated was a Douglas DC3 TP, hired in South Africa.
about.p2: Since then they have operated several types of aircraft, today having two Short 360 and one Gulfstream G159, operating from two bases: Kinshasa, the headquarters of the company, and Goma, where the two SD360s are based.
about.p3: The company has evolved since its creation following the recommendations of the Civil Aviation Authority (AAC) and the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO).
about.p4: Safety, security and professionalism are the engine that governs the operations of the company and administers its employees, from the sentry to the responsible manager who guarantees the application of these criteria.
about.p5: Our greatest wish is to have you on board, or to transport your cargo to its destination safely and at the most competitive cost.

services.title: Our services
services.lead: Passengers or cargo, on long runways or short ones.

passengerSd360.name: Passenger flight — Short 360
passengerSd360.body: With a capacity of 30 seats, the Short 360 lets you travel safely across the whole of the DRC. Its ability to take off and land on short, unpaved runways makes it essential for reaching localities that cannot be accessed by road.

passengerG159.name: Passenger flight — Gulfstream G159
passengerG159.body: The Gulfstream G159 is a fast, capable aircraft able to cover distances of more than 1,800 km with 24 passengers on board, in optimal comfort, at over 450 km/h and at an altitude close to that of airliners.

cargo.name: Cargo flight
cargo.body: With its 30 m³ hold and wide cargo door, the Short 360 will carry your freight safely to its destination.
